lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Unit assessment: graphs tables and equations

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Unit assessment. Work alone, show your steps, and check your work before you finish.

items.prompt:
Relationship A (proportional):
x: 1, 2, 3
y: 4, 8, 12
Relationship B: y = 2x
Which relationship has the greater rate of change (unit rate)?
choices: They have the same rate of change.
The rate of change cannot be determined from this information.

items.prompt: For the line y = -3x - 5, find y when x = 5.
A line has equation y = (-1/3)x + 2. Which of these equations represents a line parallel to it?
A line has equation y = 9x + 14. Write the equation of the line through (-3, -33) that is parallel to this line.
A moving company's total cost is given by C = 5h + 4, where C is the total cost in dollars and h is the number of hours of labor. What does the slope represent in this context?
choices: The company charges $4 for each additional hour of labor.
The company charges a flat fee of $4 before any labor hours.
The company charges a flat fee of $5 before any labor hours.
The company charges $5 for each additional hour of labor.

items.prompt: The amount of water in a tank is given by G = 12t + 15, where G is the number of gallons in the tank and t is the number of minutes since filling started. What does the y-intercept represent in this context?
choices: The tank already had 12 gallons of water before filling started.
The tank fills at a rate of 12 gallons per minute.
The tank already had 15 gallons of water before filling started.
The tank fills at a rate of 15 gallons per minute.

items.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (-14, -16) and (-6, -18).

A line passes through these points:
x: -10, -3, 4
y: 19, 11, 3
What is the slope (rate of change) of the line?

A line passes through (-3, -5). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 1 and a vertical leg (rise) of 8. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 3 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?
A line has a slope of -4/5. A right triangle drawn along the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 51 units. What is the length of the other leg?
Write the equation, in slope-intercept form, of a line with slope -4/3 and y-intercept -18.
Identify the slope and y-intercept of the line -7x + y = 17. Rearrange into slope-intercept form first.
